findings.title: Violated Mandate 8b 800-line monolith limit and duplicate doctor payroll calculation
findings.description: staffPayrollEngine.ts bloated to 1,172 lines (violating Mandate 8b and file header line 27). calculateDoctorPeriodPayroll was duplicated verbatim in lines 505-733, and calculateAssistantPeriodPayroll was duplicated in lines 872-918.
findings.resolution: Promoted full piece-rate calculation with storno, warranties, and multi-doctor splitting to packages/shared/src/finance/doctorPayrollT51.ts. Re-exported canonical engine and types from @dental/shared/payroll. Shrunk staffPayrollEngine.ts to 796 lines.

findings.title: Double deduction contradiction in Form T-51 payslip HTML violating Labor Code RF Art. 137
findings.description: generateDoctorT51Html displayed Lab and Materials inside Section 2 'Удержания и налоги' and summed them into 'Всего удержано' with NDFL. Because Lab and Materials were already deducted from Gross Revenue before calculating piece-rate commission, 'Всего начислено - Всего удержано' did not equal 'Итого к выплате', causing illegal payroll statement mismatch.
findings.resolution: Separated pre-commission clinical cost deductions (Section 2) from statutory salary withholdings under Labor Code RF Art. 137 (Section 3). 'Всего удержано' now strictly reflects NDFL 13%, and 'Начислено - Удержано = К выплате' balances to the kopeck.
